limitations: Finite-sample comparison on this machine and these inputs only. Each seed contributes the median of repeated proofs in one process per variant. Reported 95% bootstrap intervals resample paired seed ratios, not individual proofs; three seeds give weak uncertainty estimates and do not establish nonregression. Missing fixture caches are primed in a separate untimed process before either paired measurement. RSS is process lifetime high-water memory, including fixture setup and warmups, not per-proof allocated memory. Preparation and fixture generation are excluded from total_prover_ms.
